notes.title: Update 1.1 Out Now
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Below is a rundown of the new update. I'm also currently working on a content update that will add more interesting features and additions to the game. As always, if you encounter any bugs or have any feedback you can send it to unicorndengames@gmail.com or post it in the Steam discussions area.


Changelog:
[list]
[*] Refined the tutorial

[*] Increased the Executive Office rent

[*] Added an options tab

[*] Added the ability to mute music separately from sound effects

[*] Fixed a sound bug with some offices

[*] Added more notifications that explain why a room can't be built if conditions aren't met 

[*] Fixed resource placement bug

[*] Added Custom Game options when starting a new game

[/list]
